_meta.name: grading-framework-p0-p3
_meta.deskripsi: Grading framework detail P0/P1/P2/P3 dengan skill matrix, career path, promotion criteria, kompensasi, benefit. V4.0 - Bab 50.

P0_junior_operasional.definisi: PIC level entry, fresh graduate atau pengalaman 0-2 tahun, supervised work
P0_junior_operasional.skill_required: Basic skill sesuai divisi, willingness to learn, fast follower

P1_senior_operasional.definisi: PIC senior, pengalaman 2-5 tahun, semi-independent, bisa lead tim kecil 1-2 orang
P1_senior_operasional.skill_required: Intermediate skill sesuai divisi, leadership basic, problem solving
P1_senior_operasional.responsibility_scope: Eksekusi task mandiri 100% + supervisi P0 + project lead kecil

P2_kepala_divisi.definisi: Kepala divisi / triple role, pengalaman 5+ tahun, full independent, lead tim 3-5 orang
P2_kepala_divisi.skill_required: Advanced skill + leadership + strategic thinking + budgeting
P2_kepala_divisi.tools: Semua tools divisi + tools manajerial (Notion, Dashboard, dll)
P2_kepala_divisi.responsibility_scope: Full accountability untuk 1 divisi + strategic planning + reporting ke Mada

P3_owner_director.definisi: Owner / Co-Director, profit sharing, strategic decision final
P3_owner_director.skill_required: Vision, leadership, networking, financial acumen, public speaking

criteria: Mampu supervise 1-2 junior atau tim kecil
Feedback positif dari Mada + kepala divisi + konsumen
Lead tim 3-5 orang + project besar sukses
P1_to_P2.approval: Mada propose + Pak Ardian final approve

criteria: Bukti profit growth signifikan selama memimpin

P1_senior: Bonus tahunan 1 bulan gaji (jika company profitable)
P3_owner: Akses ke semua benefits + privilege owner

P0_skill_checklist: Basic task execution sesuai SOP divisi
Response time < 4 jam untuk task urgent
P1_skill_checklist: Bisa lead tim kecil (1-2 orang) + supervise task
